info.name: Treasury
info.description: Asset ledger with consent-based settlement. Set operatorKey to OPERATOR_KEY from .env, then run the folders in order: every request stores what the next one needs.

item.description: Two assets, two fresh accounts, two deposits. Assets may already exist, so 409 is fine there.

item.name: 3 Swap: offer, hold, approve, settle
item.description: Alice offers 100 USD for 1.5 XAU. Her USD goes on hold at once, Bob's XAU moves only when he approves, both legs settle in one statement.

exec: pm.test("202: two debtors, waiting for Bob", () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));
console.log("swap " + pm.response.json().id + " pending, alice approved, bob pending");
const of = asset => rows.find(r => r.asset === asset) || {};
pm.test("USD: posted 900.00, on hold 100.00, available 800.00", () => pm.expect(of("USD")).to.include({posted: "900.00", on_hold: "100.00", available: "800.00"}));
const of = asset => rows.find(r => r.asset === asset) || {};
pm.test("USD: posted 100.00, on hold 0.00, available 100.00", () => pm.expect(of("USD")).to.include({posted: "100.00", on_hold: "0.00", available: "100.00"}));
pm.test("XAU: posted 10.000, on hold 0.000, available 10.000", () => pm.expect(of("XAU")).to.include({posted: "10.000", on_hold: "0.000", available: "10.000"}));
pm.test("the offer is in the inbox", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("swapId")));
pm.test("409: her vote is already recorded", () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test("200: the last approval settles", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: 5 Guards: no overspend, cancel, idempotency, expiry
alice tries to send 600 USD while 600 are on hold -> 422

exec: pm.test("422: held funds cannot be promised twice", () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

item.name: replay the same key and body -> same answer

exec: pm.test("same proposal id, no second transfer", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("idemId")));
pm.test("422: key reused with a different request", () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
